title: MA Links Q4 Export Diversification Plan
pitch: Off-season product pitch: Fruits, Dry Fruits & Vegetables for Oct–Dec export window
overview: MA Links currently exports mangoes, which peak in the summer season. The diversification products maintain year-round buyer relationships through the last quarter of the year (October–December).

priorityOrder.reason: Highest production (2.2–2.7M tonnes/yr), strongest export growth ($110M season target), near-perfect seasonal complement to mango.
Best-timed dry fruit for the Q4 export window with strong winter demand.
Largest volume opportunity among vegetables with recent export surge (~$210M).

fruits.whyItFits: Top pick. Production 2.2–2.7M tonnes/year. 2025 exports ~$58M; current season target $110M. Directly complements mango's summer season.
Good domestic volume; growing export presence in winter months.
Solid production; export demand continues into early winter.
Pakistan is a top-5 global date producer; niche but steady demand.

dryFruits.whyItFits: Best dry-fruit fit for Q4 quarter. Strong winter international demand.
High-value niche product; premium pricing in winter months.
Enters market in this window; steady winter demand.
Reliable volume; can be bundled with fresh date shipments.

vegetables.whyItFits: Recent export surge reported (~$210M), largest volume opportunity among vegetables.
Reliable volume; export shipments typically begin in this window.
